name: Fake SSB
description: Artificial scroll speed bug: set level percent points and speed values in a table from the pause menu.

ssb-enabled.name: Enable
ssb-enabled.description: Turn the artificial SSB on or off.

ssb-method.name: Method
ssb-method.description: Shape = stretch/squeeze the horizontal movement. Speed = speed up / slow down the whole player.

ssb-smooth.name: Smooth
ssb-smooth.description: Change the speed smoothly between points instead of in steps.
